reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and holiday-adjustment helpers, but repeats the daily-versus-moving policy instead of sharing that decision.

duplication.why: The upcoming-date handler, range handler, and budget template each encode frequency-dependent weekend handling also represented in getNextDate.

placement.why: Holiday recognition belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule policy remains spread across server handlers and budget calculation.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested scheduling changes, their model metadata, tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several implementations of the same scheduling policy, separate scan limits, and a range-window calculation coupled to holiday representation.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently apply scheduling policy outside getNextDate, while schedule-template.ts conditionally disables its adjustment and applies local policy.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily-skip/non-daily-move decision appears as nested branches in getDatesInRange, a differently shaped branch in getUpcomingDates, and isDaily/movesWeekend flags in schedule-template.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains the holidays parameter, getNextDate gains a daily-specific branch, and getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, and the budget template separately encode the frequency-dependent policy.
